frequency_question: How often do expiring bilateral resource treaties successfully receive formal written renewal or extension instruments before their expiration date?
membership_rule: Includes any formal government-to-government water-sharing, river basin, or shared boundary resource treaty facing expiration. Excludes multilateral treaties, non-resource treaties, and treaties terminated by hostility rather than expiration.

cases.name: India-Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty continuous operations/modifications

provenance_note: 6 cases named, 7 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 6 named; believed roughly 7 in total for major structured bilateral water treaties facing explicit sunset clauses in the modern era.
known_gaps: Minor border water arrangements between smaller states lacking public diplomatic archives.
skeleton: Total identified expiring or renegotiated bilateral water treaties matching criteria divided by successful formal renewal instruments executed prior to expiration.
multiplier: 6 hits / 7 total documented instances in comparable baseline class
validity_reason: State practice regarding water treaty renewals changes slowly over decades barring major systemic geopolitical shifts.
